title: US diplomats walk out of UN meeting after France criticizes Trump's human rights record
summary: The United States walked out of a UN Security Council meeting on Tuesday, following days of public criticism from France over the reappointment of UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Volker Turk. The US had opposed the reappointment, while France and other countries criticized the move as an attack on human rights. The row sparked after the US joined North Korea and Russia in voting against extending the term of the UN high commissioner for human rights. The meeting was attended by diplomats from over 100 countries, but the US delegation left before the end of the session.
summary_points: The United States walked out of a UN Security Council meeting on Tuesday
France criticized the US move as an attack on human rights
The row sparked after the US joined North Korea and Russia in voting against extending the term of the UN high commissioner for human rights
